item.title: Dismayed by conditionality of homeless shelter | Letter
item.description: On Jan. 8, I was accepted at a homeless shelter in Augusta. I had been homeless since Oct. 31, 2025, so this news felt like a blessing. It meant no more nights outside and less uncertainty about my safety. I believed I was on a path toward stability. I spent one night at the shelter. […]

item.title: Maine basketball teams learn their NCAA DIII tournament draws
item.description: Bowdoin, Bates women will host during first and second rounds, while the Bates, Saint Joseph's and UMF men, and UMF women, will hit the road.

item.title: Portland City Council delays vote on plan to request payments from tax-exempt property owners
item.description: Officials said they want to separate a proposed Payment-In-Lieu of Taxes policy from a controversy over recent assessing decisions that have impacted the tax-exempt status of several organizations.

item.title: Biddeford residents discuss UNE projects at public hearing
item.description: Those attending the newly revived Institutional Zone Review Committee's first public hearing said they are looking for transparency and communication from the university.

item.title: South Portland’s Skillin Elementary School unlikely to be considered for closure
item.description: A majority of school board members said they would not shutter the city’s most diverse elementary school, even if it would save the most money in their quest to trim more than $7 million from the proposed budget.

item.title: Celtics rout Bucks in Giannis Antetokounmpo’s returns
item.description: Hugo González has a double-double and Boston wins for the seventh time in eight games.
